crop.notes: The clipping is the whole of page 3 at low resolution. The Allen item is 'The Local Delegation: Prominent St. Louisans Who Will Be at the Ring Side', column 3, upper half.

ocr.notes: Transcript is mostly the Sullivan-train item from column 1 and never mentions Allen; its 'Local Delegation' paragraph wrongly says Chicago. The Allen sentences were read only from an enlarged view of the low-resolution page and are blurry.

title.suggested: Allen to join St. Louis party at the Sullivan-Corbett fight

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch listed Tom Allen, "America's ex-heavyweight champion," among the St. Louisans going to New Orleans for the Sullivan-Corbett fight, accompanied by his old backer and friends.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Friday, September 2, 1892, page 3.

facts.fact: Allen was to travel from St. Louis to New Orleans with a party of friends and his old backer for the Sullivan-Corbett fight; the delegation was to leave Sunday morning

notes: Needs a proper crop of 'The Local Delegation' (column 3) and a fresh transcript; the low-resolution page makes names (e.g. Allen's backer, 'Fred W...') unreadable. The current summary (McCoole, Mace, Harry Sommers in Chicago) is not supported by the page.
